question: Which chapter of the Prāsādamaṇḍana concludes with this colophon?
premises: It identifies the second chapter in the section on platform, sight defects, and shrines.
inference: This is the end of the second chapter in that section of the Prāsādamaṇḍana.
plain_english: Thus ends the second chapter, in the section on platforms, sight defects, and shrines, in the Prāsādamaṇḍana.
